items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Jerome Carrington took over the band... Jerome Carrington on piano... we used to play in the pit and on the stage. So at the time I went with Earl, there was five of us went with Earl at the same time.

ctx.x: When did Earl Hines first hear you?
Well, I guess it was when I was with Dave Peyton. At the Regal. He heard me play, and after Dave Peyton left, then Jerome Carrington took over the band.
